highlights: August 18 first day; January 6 second-semester start
October 12-13 have no student classes for different reasons
December 18 is professional learning, not early release
May 26 early release; February 26 and April 30 marked no school
paragraphs: Midland ISD begins classes Tuesday, August 18, 2026, on the district academic calendar. October 12 is district professional learning, and October 13 is a parent-teacher conference day; students have no school on both dates. November 9 is another campus professional-learning day. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, with students back Monday, November 30.

The December 18 grading-cycle boundary is also a campus professional-learning day with no classes. Winter Break is December 21-January 1, followed by January 4-5 professional learning; the second semester begins January 6. February 15 combines campus professional learning and parent/teacher conferences. March 5 has no school for professional learning immediately before the March 8-12 Spring Break, so students return March 15. Good Friday, March 26, is a no-school day.

February 26 and April 30 are marked Bad Weather Day (No School). May 26 is the last regular-year student date shown on the calendar and is an early-release day. The calendar does not separately label it Last Day of School. Sam Houston and South, Pre-K Academy at Midland College, and Early College follow separate calendars, so these district dates should not be applied to every campus.

faqs.question: When does Midland ISD start school in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students on the district calendar start Tuesday, August 18, 2026. Sam Houston and South start August 4, and Pre-K Academy at Midland College begins scheduled mandatory attendance August 17. Early College also starts August 18 but has its own calendar.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to every Midland ISD campus?
faqs.answer: No. Midland ISD posts separate calendars for Sam Houston and South Elementary, Pre-K Academy at Midland College, and Early College High School. Their starts, ends, conference days and Thanksgiving schedules differ from the district calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last student day on the Midland ISD district calendar?
faqs.answer: May 26, 2027, is the last regular-year student date shown on the calendar and is an early-release day. The academic calendar does not separately label it Last Day of School. May 27–28 are campus staff workdays.

faqs.question: When is Midland ISD Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Thanksgiving Break November 23-27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30. Early College has a shorter November 25-27 break, so its families should use the ECHS calendar instead.

faqs.question: How long is winter break for Midland ISD students?
faqs.answer: The named Winter Break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. Students also have no classes December 18 and January 4-5 for professional learning. Together with weekends, those dates create a 19-day student no-class stretch from December 18 through January 5.

faqs.question: When do Midland ISD classes resume in January 2027?
faqs.answer: The second semester starts Wednesday, January 6, 2027. January 4 and 5 are professional-learning days with no school; they are not part of the named Winter Break.

faqs.question: When is Midland ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 8-12, 2027. March 5 is a separate no-school professional-learning day immediately before it. Students return Monday, March 15, after a continuous March 5-14 stretch without classes.

faqs.question: Does Midland ISD have a fall break in October?
faqs.answer: The district PDF does not list a named fall-break week. Students have no school Monday, October 12 for district professional learning and Tuesday, October 13 for parent-teacher conferences. The next scheduled class date is October 14.

faqs.question: Which Midland ISD professional-learning days have no school?
faqs.answer: Within the regular district student year, those dates are October 12, November 9 and December 18, 2026, plus January 4-5, February 15 and March 5, 2027. February 15 also includes parent/teacher conferences. Pre-August 18 training is not counted in this list.

faqs.question: When are parent-teacher conferences on the district calendar?
faqs.answer: October 13, 2026 is a parent-teacher conference day with no school. February 15, 2027 combines conferences with campus professional learning and also has no student classes. Individual appointment times are not printed in the yearly PDF.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026 an early-release day in Midland ISD?
faqs.answer: No. The district calendar lists December 18 as the end of grading cycle 2 and a campus professional-learning day with no school. The final scheduled student attendance date before winter is Thursday, December 17.

faqs.question: Which early-release date is listed for Midland ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists early release Wednesday, May 26, 2027, at the end of grading cycle 4. It does not state a dismissal time. Early College and Pre-K Academy have additional shortened days on their own calendars.

faqs.question: What time is Midland ISD early release on May 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: The district academic calendar lists early release on May 26 but gives no dismissal time. Check your campus notice for pickup and bus times.

faqs.question: Is there school on February 15, 2027 in Midland ISD?
faqs.answer: No regular student classes are scheduled under the district calendar. The date is labeled campus professional learning and parent/teacher conferences, rather than a Presidents Day holiday. Pre-K Academy marks February 15 as a full attendance day.

faqs.question: Is there school on February 26 and April 30, 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar marks both dates Bad Weather Day (No School). Neither counts as a scheduled student attendance date. Confirm any later schedule changes through current district notices.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday, March 26, is a no-school day. The district calendar does not list Monday, March 29 as a no-school day.

faqs.question: When do Midland ISD grading cycles end?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists October 16 and December 18, 2026, then March 19 and May 26, 2027. December 18 has no classes for professional learning, while May 26 has early release. These are cycle boundaries, not report-card distribution dates.

faqs.question: How many student attendance dates does the district calendar have?
faqs.answer: The current district calendar works out to 169 scheduled student attendance dates. This calculated total excludes the listed no-school dates, including February 26 and April 30. May 26 early release counts as one attendance date, not a full-length instructional day.

faqs.question: Does the district calendar include summer learning?
faqs.answer: Yes. The PDF lists Summer Learning June 7-25, 2027, after the regular student year. It does not specify eligibility or a daily attendance schedule. Those program dates are kept separate rather than counted as regular-year attendance for every student.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Midland ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link on this page or Midland ISD's Calendars page. The printable-calendar row lists the district, Sam Houston and South, Pre-K Academy and Early College PDFs separately so families can select the applicable schedule.

faqs.question: When do Sam Houston and South Elementary start school in 2026?
faqs.answer: Both campuses follow the separate calendar beginning Tuesday, August 4, 2026. This is two weeks earlier than the Midland ISD district calendar's August 18 start; the separate PDF should be used for these schools.

faqs.question: Do Sam Houston and South Elementary follow the regular Midland ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: No. These campuses use a separate calendar beginning August 4, 2026. Their holidays, staff PD and conference dates differ from the district calendar, so families should use the Sam Houston and South schedule.

faqs.question: When is the last day for Sam Houston and South in 2027?
faqs.answer: May 28, 2027, is listed as the last day of school if no make-up days are needed. June 2–4 are possible make-up dates; follow campus notices if make-up instruction is scheduled.

faqs.question: How many student-teacher contact days does the Sam Houston and South calendar list?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists 184 student-teacher contact days, with quarter totals of 47, 43, 46 and 48. It does not explain student attendance arrangements for conference dates; families should confirm those dates with their campus.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving recess for Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving recess runs November 23-27, 2026. November 26 is also listed as Thanksgiving, but it falls inside the same recess and is not another day off. The next scheduled student date is Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: What are the Sam Houston and South winter recess dates?
faqs.answer: The official winter recess is December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. January 4 is a separate Staff PD no-class day. Including the adjoining weekends, students remain out December 19-January 4.

faqs.question: When do Sam Houston and South students return in January?
faqs.answer: The third quarter starts Tuesday, January 5, 2027. January 4 has no classes for staff PD. This is one day earlier than the January 6 second-semester return on the main district and ECHS calendars.

faqs.question: When is spring recess for these two elementary schools?
faqs.answer: Spring recess is March 8-12, 2027, and the fourth quarter starts Monday, March 15. March 12 is still a no-class recess day even though it is the endpoint of the printed third-quarter range.

faqs.question: Which staff PD days have no classes at Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: The regular-year dates are September 4, October 9 and November 6, 2026, plus January 4, February 12 and April 5, 2027. June 1–2 staff PD comes after the listed May 28 last day and is not another regular-year student closure.

faqs.question: When are parent-teacher conferences at Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists October 13-14, 2026, February 10-11, 2027 and May 26-27, 2027. It gives no meeting hours and does not label these as no-class or early-release dates. Confirm the student schedule and appointment with the campus.

faqs.question: Are conference days student holidays on this calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists parent-teacher conferences but does not specify whether students attend, leave early or have no classes. Confirm the student schedule and appointment with the campus.

faqs.question: Is there school on Columbus Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. October 12, 2026 is listed as Columbus Day under Holiday (no classes). October 13-14 are separate parent-teacher conference dates whose student attendance arrangements are not specified by the source.

faqs.question: Is Presidents Day a day off at Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: Yes. The separate calendar lists Monday, February 15, 2027 as Presidents' Day with no classes. Friday, February 12 is also a staff PD no-class day, creating a four-day student weekend including February 13-14.

faqs.question: Is March 26, 2027 listed as a holiday for these campuses?
faqs.answer: March 26 is not marked as a holiday or no-class day on the Sam Houston and South calendar. The district and ECHS calendars differ, so families should follow this campus calendar and any later campus notices.

faqs.question: Does April 5, 2027 have student classes?
faqs.answer: No. April 5 is explicitly listed as Staff PD (no classes) on the Sam Houston and South calendar. This is a separate closure, not an extension of the March 8-12 spring recess.

faqs.question: When are the possible make-up days for Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: The PDF reserves June 2-4, 2027 as possible make-up days. They are not confirmed regular attendance dates and do not change the May 28 last-day entry unless make-up instruction is required. Check campus notices to see whether any of the June make-up days will be used.

faqs.question: When is the field-trip window on this calendar?
faqs.answer: May 17-21, 2027 is the printed Field Trips window. The yearly PDF does not give trip destinations, grade assignments, departure times or permission deadlines; those details must come from the school.

faqs.question: Are early-release dates listed for Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: No. This calendar does not list an early-release date or dismissal time. Parent-teacher conference dates are not labeled as half days, so families should confirm those dates with their campus.

faqs.question: When do the four quarters end at Sam Houston and South?
faqs.answer: The four quarter end dates are October 8 and December 18, 2026, then March 12 and May 28, 2027. March 12 falls during spring recess. The calendar does not give report-card distribution dates.

faqs.question: Does this calendar include 5th Quarter?
faqs.answer: Yes. The calendar lists 5th Quarter June 22–July 17 in summer 2026, before the August 4 start of the regular 2026–2027 year. It describes voluntary summer courses that are mandatory for some students; this is not a summer 2027 program.

faqs.question: Where is the official Sam Houston and South calendar?
faqs.answer: Midland ISD lists the official download as “Sam Houston and South Elem. Calendar” on its Calendars page. This is the separate calendar for Sam Houston Collegiate Preparatory Elementary and South Elementary.

faqs.question: When does Pre-K Academy at Midland College start in 2026?
faqs.answer: Scheduled mandatory attendance begins Monday, August 17, 2026, with a full day from 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. This is the first student attendance date shown; the calendar does not print a separate First Day label.

faqs.question: What is the last mandatory school date for Pre-K Academy?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 21, 2027, is the final mandatory half day shown, ending at noon. School is closed May 24–31. The calendar does not print a separate Last Day label.

faqs.question: What are Pre-K Academy's regular school hours?
faqs.answer: Full days run 7:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m., and mandatory half days run 7:30 a.m.–noon. These hours apply to Pre-K Academy at Midland College.

faqs.question: Which Pre-K Academy dates have noon dismissal?
Does Pre-K Academy have mandatory attendance on half days?
faqs.answer: Yes. Half days are marked mandatory attendance and run 7:30 a.m.–noon.

faqs.question: Is every Friday a half day at the academy?
faqs.answer: No. There are 33 scheduled Friday half days, but some Fridays have no school. For example, March 5 is teacher professional development, and March 12 and March 26 are school closures.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving closure for Pre-K Academy?
faqs.answer: School is closed November 23–27, 2026. November 20 is a mandatory half day, and children return for a full day Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: How long are the academy's winter school closures?
faqs.answer: School is closed December 18, 2026–January 1, 2027. January 4 is a separate teacher-development day without school, so children return January 5.

faqs.question: When does Pre-K Academy return after winter?
faqs.answer: Children return Tuesday, January 5, 2027, for a full day. January 4 has no school for teacher professional development.

faqs.question: When is spring closure on the Pre-K Academy calendar?
faqs.answer: School is closed March 8–12, 2027. March 5 also has no school for teacher development, and full-day classes resume Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Which teacher-development days have no academy classes?
faqs.answer: During the regular student year, classes are off October 12 and November 9, 2026, and January 4 and March 5, 2027, for teacher professional development.

faqs.question: Is February 15, 2027 a school day at Pre-K Academy?
faqs.answer: Yes. February 15 is a mandatory full school day from 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. at Pre-K Academy at Midland College.

faqs.question: Are February 26 and April 30 bad-weather days for the academy?
faqs.answer: Both dates are mandatory half days from 7:30 a.m. to noon on the academy calendar. They are not marked as bad-weather days here.

faqs.question: Is March 26, 2027 closed at Pre-K Academy?
faqs.answer: Yes. School is closed March 26. March 29 is a mandatory full school day.

faqs.question: Does this academy calendar apply to all Midland ISD Pre-K children?
faqs.answer: No. This calendar applies only to Pre-K Academy at Midland College. Children enrolled in another Midland ISD Pre-K program should follow their assigned campus calendar.

faqs.question: What is Tuition Summer Care at Pre-K Academy?
faqs.answer: Tuition Summer Care is a separate June and July calendar category, not part of regular mandatory school attendance. The academic calendar does not give fees, enrollment details or care hours; confirm those with the academy.

faqs.question: Are parent-teacher conference dates listed for Pre-K Academy?
faqs.answer: No parent-teacher conference dates or appointment times are listed on the academy student calendar. Check with the academy for conference arrangements.

faqs.question: Where can families download the Pre-K Academy student calendar?
faqs.answer: The official PDF link here leads to the academy's color-coded student calendar. Midland ISD also lists it separately as Pre-K Academy Calendar on its Calendars page; it is distinct from the districtwide and Early College PDFs.

editorialSummary.heading: Midland ISD ECHS 2026-2027 breaks, early release and bridge dates
highlights: Four early-release dates remain student attendance dates
May 14 final grading cycle and early release
May 27-28 Summer Bridge applies to incoming ninth graders
paragraphs: Early College follows its own Midland ISD calendar even though classes begin on the same August 18 date as the district schedule. Thanksgiving Break is only November 25-27. October 12–13 and November 9 are not marked as no-school dates on the ECHS calendar. October 16 has early release for afternoon parent conferences, and November 13 has early release for afternoon professional learning.

Students have no classes December 18 for professional learning. Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, followed by professional learning January 4–5; students return January 6. February 19 has early release for afternoon parent conferences. March 5 has no school for professional learning before Spring Break, March 8–12. Good Friday, March 26, is a no-school day. February 26 and April 30 are marked Bad Weather Day (No School).

The final grading cycle ends May 14 with early release. The calendar does not separately label a Last Day of School. Summer Bridge on May 27–28 is for incoming ninth graders. The PDF is inconsistent about summer-learning dates: its table lists June 7–25, while its June calendar shades weekdays June 1–30. Families should confirm the applicable program schedule with ECHS.

faqs.question: When does Midland ISD Early College start school in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The ECHS PDF gives Tuesday, August 18, 2026 as the first day of school. Families should use this separate calendar for later breaks and shortened days, even though its opening date matches the district calendar.

faqs.question: Does Midland ISD Early College follow the regular district calendar?
faqs.answer: No. Early College has its own academic calendar. Classes begin August 18, 2026, but Thanksgiving Break is November 25–27 and its four early-release dates differ from the district schedule. Families should use the ECHS calendar.

faqs.question: When does the regular ECHS student year end in 2027?
faqs.answer: May 14, 2027, is the final grading-cycle end shown, with early release. The calendar does not separately label a Last Day of School. Summer Bridge on May 27–28 is for incoming ninth graders.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Midland ISD ECHS?
faqs.answer: ECHS Thanksgiving Break is November 25-27, 2026. November 23 and 24 are not marked as no-school dates in this PDF. Students return Monday, November 30 after the three-day break and weekend.

faqs.question: Which ECHS dates have early release in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The four dates are October 16 and November 13, 2026, then February 19 and May 14, 2027. October 16 and February 19 have afternoon parent conferences; November 13 has afternoon professional learning; May 14 ends the final grading cycle.

faqs.question: What time do ECHS students leave on shortened days?
faqs.answer: The academic PDF identifies early release but gives no dismissal times. Check the Early College school notice for pickup and bus arrangements rather than using a district or Pre-K Academy release time.

faqs.question: How long is winter break for Early College students?
faqs.answer: The ECHS named Winter Break is December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. December 18 and January 4-5 also have no classes for professional learning. The resulting student no-class stretch is December 18-January 5, including weekends.

faqs.question: When does the ECHS second semester begin?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027 for the first day of second semester. January 4 and 5 are still professional-learning days without student classes, not early-release attendance dates.

faqs.question: When is spring break on the ECHS calendar?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 8-12, 2027. Friday, March 5 is professional learning with no school, so students are out March 5-14 including weekends and return Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Which full-day professional-learning dates have no ECHS classes?
faqs.answer: During the regular ECHS student year, the no-school learning dates are December 18, 2026, January 4-5, 2027 and March 5, 2027. November 13 professional learning is in the afternoon after early release, so it is not counted as another full-day closure.

faqs.question: Does ECHS have the district October 12-13 days off?
faqs.answer: The ECHS PDF does not mark October 12 or 13 as holidays, professional-learning closures or conference no-school days. Its parent conferences instead appear with student early release Friday, October 16. Families should follow the separate ECHS calendar for these dates.

faqs.question: Is February 15, 2027 a no-school day for ECHS?
faqs.answer: The ECHS calendar does not list February 15 as a no-school day. This differs from the district calendar. ECHS lists parent conferences with early release February 19 instead; families should follow any later school-specific updates.

faqs.question: Is there school at ECHS on February 26 and April 30, 2027?
faqs.answer: Both dates are marked Bad Weather Day (No School) on the ECHS calendar and are excluded from scheduled attendance. Confirm any later schedule changes through current school or district notices.

faqs.question: Is there school at ECHS on Good Friday?
faqs.answer: Good Friday, March 26, is a no-school day. Monday, March 29 is not listed as a no-school day on the ECHS calendar.

faqs.question: When are ECHS parent conferences scheduled?
faqs.answer: October 16, 2026 and February 19, 2027 have student early release followed by Parent Conference PM. These are shortened student attendance days, not conference closures. The annual PDF does not provide appointment times.

faqs.question: Who is the May 27-28 ECHS Summer Bridge for?
faqs.answer: The PDF specifically lists Summer Bridge for incoming ninth graders on May 27 and 28, 2027. It does not give session hours or state an attendance requirement. Those dates are separate from the regular year ending at the May 14 grading-cycle boundary.

faqs.question: What are the ECHS summer-learning dates?
faqs.answer: The calendar is inconsistent: its table lists June 7–25, 2027, while the June calendar shades weekdays June 1–30. Confirm the applicable program dates and attendance details with ECHS.

faqs.question: When do ECHS grading cycles end?
faqs.answer: The listed cycle ends are October 16 and December 18, 2026, then March 19 and May 14, 2027. October 16 and May 14 have early release; December 18 has no school for professional learning. Report-card distribution dates are not supplied.

faqs.question: Where is the official Midland ISD Early College calendar?
faqs.answer: The official ECHS PDF is linked here and in Midland ISD's printable-calendar row as Early College HS Calendar. Select that download rather than the district, Pre-K Academy or Sam Houston and South schedule.
